329:t_1:4.en:
$$レモン$$
「...That's amazing, $$ナミ$$! I never imagined you'd move up to Class A while I was away!」

329:t_1:5.en:
$$ナミ$$
「It's thanks to $$宗介$$. Every match was a real thrill.」

329:t_1:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「I told you when we first met. I am a professional.」

329:t_1:9.en:
$$ナミ$$
「It's been almost three weeks since then, and I... realized I hardly know anything about you, $$宗介$$...」

329:t_1:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I'm not very good at talking about myself.」

329:t_1:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「It is no substitute, but I would like you to tell me about yourself.」

329:t_1:12.en:
$$ナミ$$
「You want to know about me?」

329:t_1:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「Well... I would like to know why you own $$チーム・クロスボウ$$, or how you got the $$Ｒｋ－９１$$...」

329:t_1:14.en:
$$ナミ$$
「...I found it, on the outskirts of my home village about a year and a half ago.」

329:t_1:16.en:
$$ナミ$$
「My village was caught up in $$クメン$$'s civil war. The people who burned down half the village left that AS behind.」

329:t_1:17.en:
$$ナミ$$
「It was practically scrap when I found it, though, so I repaired it myself.」

329:t_1:19.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I want to rebuild that village. But I'll need a lot of money to do it...」

329:t_1:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「So that's why you compete in the arena.」

329:t_1:21.en:
$$ナミ$$
「If I use my winnings to repair the ruined fields and roads, I'm sure people will come back.」

329:t_1:22.en:
$$ナミ$$
「My goal now is to restore the village's only school, the one I went to.」

329:t_1:24.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Did you go to school in Japan too, $$宗介$$?」

329:t_1:25.en:
$$宗介$$
「I did, though only for a little while...」

329:t_1:27.en:
$$宗介$$
($$ミスリル$$'s investigation found that a group resembling $$アマルガム$$ was behind this arena in $$ナムサク$$, but...)

329:t_1:28.en:
$$宗介$$
(Can I really find $$千鳥$$ if I keep doing this without the others from $c...?)

329:t_1:29.en:
$$宗介$$
(But to get a lead on the enemy, I have no choice but to keep gathering information.)

329:t_1:30.en:
$$宗介$$
(...Is that really the only reason I'm here...?)

329:t_1:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... I was thinking about tomorrow's opponent.」

329:t_1:33.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I see... Then I'll... update the fire-control system's software.」

329:t_1:34.en:
$$ナミ$$
「It's my own work, so it can't do much, but it'll make $$クロスボウ$$ stronger.」

329:t_1:38.en:
$$ナミ$$
「You... looked really cool in today's match, $$宗介$$.」

329:t_1:40.en:
$$宗介$$
(If I stay here, I won't have the grueling missions I had in $c...)

329:t_1:41.en:
$$宗介$$
(I won't have the trouble I had pretending to be a high school student in $$東京$$ either...)

329:t_1:42.en:
$$宗介$$
(Someone else can deal with $$アマルガム$$ and $$サイデリアル$$. It is not my duty.)

329:t_1:43.en:
$$宗介$$
(It hasn't even been a month, but honestly, I'm starting to think this sort of life isn't bad...)

329:t_1:45.en:
$$宗介$$
(...I can't remember the color of the shoes $$千鳥$$ usually wore... Or which wrist she wore her watch on...)

329:t_1:46.en:
$$宗介$$
(I've even forgotten the color of the ribbon tying back that long hair I must have seen every day...)

329:t_1:47.en:
$$宗介$$
(Worse... I'm starting to forget even her smile...)

329:t_1:50.en:
$$レモン$$
「What do you mean, 'You were here'? I called you over and over, and you ignored me.」

329:t_1:51.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm sorry... I was lost in thought.」

329:t_1:52.en:
$$レモン$$
「Why don't we go out for a change of pace? There's something I want to talk about.」

329:t_1:58.en:
$$宗介$$
「...While we're out, I'll look for the parts $$ナミ$$ wanted.」

329:t_1:59.en:
$$レモン$$
「I'm surprised. Even with an arena here, I never thought an ordinary market like this would sell AS parts.」

329:t_1:60.en:
$$レモン$$
「All of these are outdated models, right? They're developing new AS models all the time...」

329:t_1:61.en:
$$宗介$$
(...Major $$カリーニン$$ pointed it out too, but weapons evolve at an abnormal pace in the multiverse.)

329:t_1:62.en:
$$宗介$$
(That isn't limited to ASes. $$カミーユ$$ and the others say mobile suits and other mobile weapons are the same.)

329:t_1:63.en:
$$宗介$$
(What they have in common is a basically humanoid form. Is that a coincidence...?)

329:t_1:65.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm not saying you can't take pictures. But aren't you being a little too intrusive?」

329:t_1:66.en:
$$レモン$$
「Well... Your expression stirred the artist in me, and I couldn't help myself...」

329:t_1:68.en:
$$レモン$$
「Actually, I'm interested in your art... your combat skills too.」

329:t_1:69.en:
$$レモン$$
「I feel your superb fighting goes beyond skill. As a photographer, I sense art in it.」

329:t_1:71.en:
$$レモン$$
「You're different from the arena's fighters. You're looking toward some great... far-off goal.」

329:t_1:72.en:
$$レモン$$
「Otherwise, you couldn't learn to fight like that. That's the feeling I got.」

329:t_1:73.en:
$$宗介$$
(I thought he was just a carefree reporter, but apparently there's more to him...)

329:t_1:74.en:
$$レモン$$
「Well? Am I off the mark?」

329:t_1:75.en:
$$宗介$$
「You may be right. After all, this is about the only way I know to express myself.」

329:t_1:76.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Did you take me out here just to talk about that?」

329:t_1:78.en:
$$レモン$$
「I'll be direct. ...Take $$ナミ$$ and leave the city.」

329:t_1:80.en:
$$レモン$$
「Something big is about to happen in this city.」

329:t_1:81.en:
$$レモン$$
「My research says the people running the arena from behind the scenes got too greedy, and their superiors are going to purge them.」

329:t_1:83.en:
$$宗介$$
(Is $$アマルガム$$ going to burn this city...?!)

329:t_1:84.en:
$$レモン$$
「I don't want to see her caught up in it. ...Can I count on you, $$相良宗介$$... $$ウルズ$$ 7?」

329:t_1:85.en:
$$宗介$$
(How does he... know my call sign...?)
